title: Alex vs. America
description:
S03 E05 — Alex vs Salmon
Eric Adjepong welcomes three of the country's most skilled salmon experts to prove their knowledge of fish can compete with Alex Guarnaschelli's experience; the ingredients they choose could give them an advantage or help Alex.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S03 E07 — Alex vs Pastry
Eric Adjepong welcomes three pastry chefs from Kentucky, California and New Jersey to outshine Alex Guarnaschelli's pastry expertise; the chefs pull out all the stops for judges Sherry Yard and Stephanie Boswell to give Alex a run for her money.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E08 — Leftovers Gone Wild!
In the appetizer round, the chefs show that they have what it takes to transform leftovers into a meal; in the entrée round, the competitors attempt to impress the judges using a variety of tools and techniques.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E01 — Military Salute: Navy
U.S. Navy chefs will have to create spectacular appetizers using an aged meat product before reworking a patriotic cake for dessert, all with $75,000 for a charitable cause on the line.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E02 — Military Salute: Air Force
Four members of the U.S. Air Force compete; in the appetizer basket, the chefs find a bowl of something comforting and a crunchy snack, while the dessert round includes a wild play on pickles.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E03 — Military Salute: Marines
Chopped welcomes the U.S. Marine Corps chefs to the kitchen; the competitors must figure out how to make something that's normally ready-to-eat ready for the judges and get creative when a breakfast food appears in the basket.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E04 — Military Salute: Army
Four chefs from the U.S. Army transform a favorite soldier comfort food into an elevated appetizer; a festive drink shakes up the competitors in the dessert round as they fight for a spot in the tournament's finale.

title: Chopped
description:
S55 E05 — Military Salute: Finale
The four military finalists cook as a team against a mystery "Chopped" judge in every round; their teamwork and creativity will be tested as they battle against star chefs for the chance to win $75,000 for a charitable cause.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S37 E01 — Chopped Takedown
Alex Guarnaschelli and Marc Murphy band together with chefs Daniel Le and Michael Michaelis to teach Bobby Flay a thing or two about lobster.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S40 E04 — Arrivederci, Bobby!
Jeff Mauro and comedian Chelsea Peretti bring Bobby Flay the laughs as they cheer on Italian chefs Antonio de Ieso and Ciro Fodera.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S40 E07 — This Is How We Roll
Bobby Flay is way out of his element with a signature dish he's never made before; Damaris Phillips and Christian Petroni taunt him as chefs Ilji Cheung and Pyet Despain attempt to roll up a win.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E08 — Today's Forecast: Defeat
Bobby Flay meets his match when meteorologist Ginger Zee and Sunny Anderson storm the kitchen with chefs Basil Yu and Sanjay Rawat.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E12 — Titans vs. An Iron Chef
An OG Iron Chef is ready to show Bobby Flay's Titans who's boss; it's not this contender's first time in the TT kitchen, but this time, he brings his knives; Bobby's good friend and industry veteran Stephen Kalt decides who will be victorious.

title: Bobby Flay's the Line
description:
S01 E10 — Dale Talde: Goosefeather
Time is not on their side when the clock gets the best of the chefs in a Cantonese cook-off between Bobby Flay's home team and Dale Talde's visiting line.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S02 E01 — The Holly Jolly Holiday Tournament Returns
Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E05 — Just Another Flay in The Office
Chef Christian Petroni and actress Kate Flannery from "The Office" recruit chefs Josh Gale and Christian Ortiz for a hostile takeover of Bobby Flay's kitchen.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E09 — Bottoms Up, Bobby Down!
Actress, comedian and foodie Aisha Tyler and Katie Lee Biegel get crafty.

title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate
description: We make delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S19 E03 — Friendsgiving Favorites
Special guests Ted Allen, Christian Petroni and Martina McBride join the group for a Friendsgiving filled with Turkey Day favorites; sweet-and-spicy smoked turkey and smoked gravy; triple sec cranberry relish; fried Brussels sprouts.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S40 E08 — Fall Festival Favorites
The kitchen is making their favorite fall festival treats, including the ultimate pumpkin bread, honey-fried turkey legs with Japanese BBQ sauce and apple fritters with hot honey glaze; a game of Try or Deny features some unexpected fall flavors!

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E09 — Titans vs. Ashleigh Shanti
Bobby Flay invites rising star Chef Ashleigh Shanti to face-off against the Titans; she keeps the Titans guessing with her unique mix of Appalachian and Southern cooking, while Chef Wylie Dufresne doles out his criticisms.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E08 — Titans vs. Katsuji Tanabe
Chef Katsuji Tanabe's bravado is as big as his desire to take down Bobby Flay's Titans; Katsuji is desperate for his first big win, and it's up to judge Judy Joo to decide if it's his turn for victory.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E07 — Titans vs. Kaleena Bliss
Chef Kaleena Bliss is on a competition winning streak; chef Kaleena is beaten Bobby Flay, and now he's invited her to try her luck at the Titans, while Bobby's protégé, Chef Hillary Sterling, dishes out tough critiques.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E10 — Titans vs. Michael Jenkins
The Titans think they're ready to go up against Alex Guarnaschelli's protégé, Chef Michael Jenkins; Michael has judged each of the Titans before and uses that knowledge to his advantage.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E02 — Best Noodles Ever
Guy Fieri sends chefs running down aisles in this high-stakes competition.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E04 — Red, White, and Food
Guy Fieri invites three GGG winners to celebrate America's 250th birthday with a cook-off. First, the chefs make a picnic plate with ingredients like apple pie and corn dogs. Then, a game of cornhole determines the ingredients for a grilled dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S19 E10 — GGG Winners' Holiday Extravaganza
Four previous winners return for the holidays to take on more of Guy Fieri's games; chefs must shop for ingredients using nothing but oversized stockings; chefs are given a gingerbread house that they must flip into a fine dining holiday dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S28 E08 — Fieri Family Holiday Showdown
Guy Fieri's two sons and nephew face off; Guy pairs each family member with their very own all-star chef partner, but he also gives each team a Secret Santa box full of weird ingredients to use.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S35 E06 — GGG Best Buddies Holiday Special
Guy Fieri teams up some of his friends from the Best Buddies volunteer organization with some all-star chefs for a holiday cook-off; the teams have one hour to make a holiday entrée and dessert for a chance to earn $15,000 for their teammate.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E01 — Memorable Firsts and Magic
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E02 — The Chamber Challenge
James and Oliver ask the baking teams to bring the Basilisk, Moaning Myrtle, a Howler and Hermione as a cat to life in their cakes; the showpieces are presented to judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain in the iconic Chamber of Secrets itself.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E02 — The Time of Your Life
After a peppermint dessert preheat, Jesse Palmer asks the baking teams to make radical red velvet desserts in honor of Santa's fresh fit; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh choose the winner of the $1,000 prize package.

title: Chopped
description:
S44 E04 — Holiday Sweethearts
Four judges compete alongside their significant others in a festive, feisty battle between friends. As the teams endeavor to create appetizers quickly, they must figure out how to use novelty pasta and a splendid fruit on their plates.

title: Chopped
description:
S61 E09 — Mizuna Matata
Four chefs are eager to impress as they race to make appetizers with mizuna and a weird pizza, but first round jitters are a real problem; a deep-fried oddity is part of the challenge for the competitors in the second round.

title: Giada's Holiday Handbook
description:
S05 E04 — Thankful For You
Giada De Laurentiis and her daughter, Jade, host a holiday party for friends; Jade helps prepare the menu, prep for the party and plan the activity of making homemade Christmas gifts for a teacher; the menu is a gourmet twist on kid favorites.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E01 — Home for the Holidays
In their first challenge, each baker must create a holiday showpiece that represents how they celebrate at home; Judges Yolanda Gampp and Jacques Torres choose the top six bakers to become empire leaders.

title: Kids Baking Championship
description:
Season's Sweetings
Five fan-favorite kid bakers are challenged to create festive gingerbread house cakes.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E02 — Santa to the Rescue!
Five teams of cake and sugar artists must imagine what happens outside the North Pole and make a creation symbolizing Santa Claus as a world hero.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E03 — The Great Turkey Escape
Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E04 — When Toys Come Alive ... And Go Wild
The five teams show the judges what happens when too much holiday magic happens and newly minted toys come alive, escape from their boxes and go crazy.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E06 — North Pole Wedding
Raven-Symoné challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole; judges Shinmin Li and Erin Acevedo decide which team will go home with $25,000.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E05 — Critter Christmas
The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom.

title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E03 — I'm Dreaming of a Bright Christmas
Host Jesse Palmer challenges the teams to create a holiday light show out of gingerbread and pair their glittering creations with the lightest of all desserts: choux pastry; judges Nacho Aguirre, Kardea Brown and Breegan Jane choose the winning team.

title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E01 — Best in Show
The baking teams are tasked with creating holiday memory snow globe scenes in gingerbread; they must also make a treat using the most common baking ingredient to represent snow — coconut.

title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E02 — Have Yourself a Scary Little Christmas
The Abominable Snowman inspires the challenge theme, "A Monster Christmas"; the teams must make an oozing caramel dessert to go with their display.

title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S01 E04 — Holiday Window Shop 'til You Drop
The best part of shopping at the holidays is seeing all the window decorations, so the baking teams are asked to turn their favorite holiday window scene into a gingerbread display with an animated element and a champagne dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S10 E05 — Holiday Beauty
Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with turning beautiful holiday designs into mini-tart mosaics; the bakers make merry and bright double-barrel wrapping paper cakes that feel like the perfect gift for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S10 E06 — Holiday Imagination
After learning the latke basics, Jesse Palmer has the bakers fry up latke-inspired desserts; the bakers' imaginations run wild while creating letterboard holiday bars to put judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller in the holiday spirit.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S10 E07 — Reasons for the Season
Jesse Palmer explores holiday traditions by challenging the bakers to craft Kwanzaa plantain desserts, make large edible ornaments and create puff pastry Christmas tree pull-aparts for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller to tear into.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S10 E08 — Holiday Gifts Galore
Jesse Palmer leads three Christmas Eve challenges as the finalists upgrade Santa's cookies with macaron wreaths, stuff their stockings with éclairs and build showstopping holiday train cakes for the title of Holiday Baking Champion.

title: Holiday Baking Championship

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E10 — Shepherd's Pie and Sunday Dinner Sundaes
Noah Cappe visits the Big E in West Springfield, Mass., to try the turducken sandwich, Country Fried Shepherd's Pie, deep-fried fruit punch and The Big E-clair; Gwinnett County Fair in Georgia features Sunday Dinner Sundae and the Funnel Fried Bacon.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E09 — Dumplings and Pumpkins
Noah visits the North Florida Fair in Tallahassee for dead heat tacos, the bacon blast and the belly buster Philly cheesesteak; the Erin Fall Fair in Ontario, Canada serves up Ag Ladies apple dumplings, pork belly sliders and crackle lanterns.

title: Tournament of Champions
description:
S06 E07 — Down to the Great 8
Fieri welcomes the Great 8 back into the arena to compete in the tough quarterfinals; eight of the world's best chefs go head-to-head in four sudden death battles and deal with the randomizer to earn a trip to the finale.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E02 — The Time of Your Life
After a peppermint dessert preheat, Jesse Palmer asks the baking teams to make radical red velvet desserts in honor of Santa's fresh fit; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh choose the winner of the $1,000 prize package.

S03 E02 — The Chamber Challenge

description:

Fieri is back to host a holiday showdown in a Winner's Wonderland! All-new teams of 32 superstar chefs create sweet and savory delights in hopes of sleighing the competition, winning the title, scoring $100,000 and delivering big bucks for charity.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E11 — Turkey-Giving
In Princeton, N.J., a crêpe restaurant has a new take on a turkey club; in Somersworth, N.H., a turkey meatloaf and a haddock sandwich; in Louisville, Ky., a restaurant practices a pay-what-you-can business model.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E04 — Bird and Beef
Guy Fieri travels the country, digging into awesome bird and beef; in Longmont, a fried chicken emporium serves up their specialty along with unique chicharrones.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S29 E06 — From Big Burgers to Little Italy
A funky joint in Little Rock, Ark., pairs their craft brews with all kinds of on-the-bun creations; two brothers put out real deal Italian food; a sandwich shop in Santa Rosa, Calif., dishes out all kinds of righteous recipes.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S30 E02 — Whole Lotta Comfort
Hearty helpings of comfort include a soul food spot dishing out Southern seafood and killer fried chicken in Atlanta.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S32 E01 — A World of Barbecue
Guy Fieri is firing up an entire world of barbecue, from chicken salad in Delaware to Argentinian flavor in San Diego and a traditional Hawaiian pig roast down in the ground in Kauai, Hawaii.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S32 E13 — From Australian to Asian
A Japanese-Hawaiian spot putting a quick spin on fish, burgers and burritos; a bakery cooking up Down Under comfort food like meat pies and sausage rolls; a funky joint serving international mashups like Pasta Chihuahua and an oxtail tostada.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S33 E08 — Bagels, Biscuit and Boar
Guy Fieri is diggin' into all kinds of flavor, starting in Santa Fe, N.M., at a pub serving comfort grub like chicken and biscuits and in-the-shell clam chowder.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S41 E07 — Tacos, Tots and Chops
Guy Fieri enjoys a fun, filling fiesta, kicking off in Grand Junction, Colo., where a pub serves a real deal Reuben; a spot in Salt Lake City elevates tacos; an outrageous joint in Nashville, Tenn., cooks up Middle Eastern specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S42 E07 — From Italian to Asian
Guy Fieri starts at a Vietnamese spot in Albuquerque, N.M., with banh mi; in Anchorage, Alaska, there's real Italian deli.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S44 E05 — Beef and Bird
Loading up the meat with bomb beef and bird; in North Conway, N.H., a funky joint is putting Thai in their tacos, and a local gem in Emerald Isle, N.C., is firin' up big barbecue; in Taos, N.M., a traditional spot serves up New Mexican specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S45 E02 — Smoker, Stove and Skewer
Guy Fieri is checking out all kinds of culinary spots, like a Las Vegas food truck smoking up monster sandwiches and a California comfort spot with pot pie; a Mediterranean joint's beef skewers and tandoori chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S47 E10 — Flavor Explosion
Guy Fieri's diving into a flavor overload; a rockin' food truck in Mobile, AL, is dishing out next-level tacos, while an Indian joint in Alberta, Canada, is serving up street food with flair; in Los Angeles, a vegan oasis puts a spin on Bolognese.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S50 E07 — All Over Flavor
Guy Fieri's getting into flavors from all over, starting with a Vietnamese spot in Boston that's dishing out rocking rice noodle rolls; Guy finds a legit lamb meatball sub and knockout octopus in Montana.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S52 E06 — All Kinds of Cookin'
Guy Fieri is digging into cheffed-up eats of all kinds; a "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" alum is sourcing local Decatur, Ga., ingredients for coffee-dusted venison; a joint in Texas is topping its bagels with basil schmears.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S55 E03 — From Bunny Chow to Chicken Oysters
Guy Fieri's digging into the unexpected; a South African spot in Black Mountain, N.C., is cooking lights-out lamb curry; a chef in San Jose, Calif., is bringing big flavor to beef barbacoa; a Boynton Beach, Fla., joint is serving up chicken oysters.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S54 E03 — Pizza, Pastrami and Potato Skins
Guy Fieri explores comfort food at an Austin deli serving pastrami and a Calgary restaurant offering brisket and ribs.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
Northwest, Southeast
Fieri's finding flavor from the Southeast to Northwest! A Seattle sandwich spot is serving up funkalicous falafel. In Myrtle Beach, SC, a BBQ joint is putting out the-bomb burnt ends mac, and a shop is scratch-making savory and sweet NY-style bagels.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S56 E01 — Hand to Mouth
Guy Fieri's grabbing flavor by the handful! Two buddies are slinging Italian sandwiches in Tampa; a spot near Sacramento, Calif., is putting their spin on crispy cod tacos; a Latin-inspired food truck is bringing comfort fusion to South Florida.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S54 E07 — Smoked, Fried, and Aged
Guy's savoring smoked, fried, and dry-aged delights!
